fitAgainstVentedDryer.rationale: Three independent manufacturers (Samsung DV22N, LG DLHC1455, Whirlpool HybridCare W10764068) document standalone heat-pump ventless dryers whose functional architecture cannot be represented by vented_dryer rev2 without canonical mutation. vented_dryer requires heated_airflow_path terminating at exhaust_path with heat_source on the air stream. Heat-pump dryers use refrigerant-cycle heat transfer, sealed/ventless process airflow, condensation-based moisture rejection (tank/drain/sump), and compressor/refrigerant thermal protection — not optional omissions of exhaust_path.
superficialOverlapsPreserved: lint filter restriction (without exhaust terminal pairing)
